title: Unique Braised Jamaican Sweetcorn Stew
description: A cultured and pillowy Jamaican dish featuring sweetcorn, perfect for a hangover cure, this sugar-free-friendly stew is a delicious and comforting meal. It combines the flavors of Jamaica with the sweetness of corn.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced scotch bonnet peppers and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sweetcorn, thyme, and allspice, and stir to combine.
Pour in the coconut milk and chicken broth, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and braise, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the corn is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
